plan.title: Live RFQ counter offer remains pending

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Use an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Create the two-line event required by the scenario.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a live bidding window.
Invite one vendor whose bid will receive the counter offer.
Submit a normal vendor bid; the single supported price is used for both lines.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Reach the buyer's Responses view and confirm the vendor response is available.
Verify the buyer sees one normal, non-surrogate vendor response.
Open the comparison grid, which is the catalog-supported surface for initiating a counter offer.
Send a counter offer while bidding remains live; the supported action applies one counter price across the sheet.
Confirm the vendor bid is marked as having a counter offer initiated.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor sees the pending counter offer and has not answered it.
Try a vendor revision while the counter offer is pending; the action must be refused.
Return to the buyer's event page without accepting the counter offer.
Reopen the buyer's Master QCS after the vendor leaves the offer unanswered.
Confirm the counter offer remains pending/initiated rather than accepted.
Verify the Master QCS still shows internally consistent current rate, quantity, line amount, and total arithmetic.
